about:
House of Brands, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Yankton, South Dakota, where it operates a dedicated production facility at 3104 Douglas Avenue. The business is owned by Andy Holst, who serves as CEO, and Jen Holst, both of whom lead a team of decoration and client-service specialists.

The company provides full-service branded merchandise programs, sourcing promotional products and custom apparel while performing all decoration in-house. Core processes include embroidery on Tajima commercial machines, screen printing, and a proprietary fusion method, supplemented by digitizing, 3D puff embroidery, and patch application. The facility also supports large-format printing, print collateral, and managed webstore, franchise, pop-up, and school merchandise programs.

Customers range from multi-unit franchises such as Stand Strong Fencing San Antonio to small businesses, startups, schools, and corporate marketing departments. The team works directly with franchise owners, entrepreneurs, and organizational buyers to maintain brand consistency across locations and events.

The founders built the company after recognizing that many buyers had unpleasant experiences ordering branded merchandise; they aimed to deliver a reliable, enjoyable process backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee, dedicated client-relations experts available weekdays, and one of the industry's fastest standard turnaround times.
